homeEN.introduction: Hello, welcome! I am {{age}} years old, a junior full-stack developer, and I live in Sorocaba/SP. Feel free to get to know my work better.
homeEN.DescriptionI: Developed institutional websites for CEAVO and INTTERCOM using WordPress and low-code solutions, focusing on lead generation and SEO optimization. Also created the Pedido Fácil system, a SaaS platform for order management, which reduced service time by 40% and eliminated manual errors through access level authentication, offline support, and integration with thermal printers.
homeEN.DescriptionII: Worked on critical infrastructure projects for banks such as Santander, Caixa, Itaú, and Sicred. Replaced 300+ CPUs and reinstalled systems in 100+ branches, resulting in a 300% increase in equipment performance. Implemented 500+ lottery terminals, upgraded physical networks, and ensured high availability in mission-critical environments, increasing security and maintainability by 70%.
homeEN.DescriptionIII: Implemented a web application for automating appointment scheduling for consultations and exams, reducing service time by 60%. Developed an API with Nest.js for automated patient triage and participated in the creation of a SaaS platform for project management, which increased team productivity by 35%. Also implemented accessibility features such as colorblind-friendly themes and font adjustment, expanding usability for all users.
homeEN.DescriptionIV: Developed a mobile application for APAE Sorocaba focused on fundraising and social campaigns, connecting the community to the institution. The digital solution resulted in an increase of over 40% in donations received, connecting the community to the institution more efficiently.
homeEN.projectsIntro: Here are some of the projects I've worked on, showcasing my skills in full-stack development and my passion for creating efficient and modern solutions.
homeEN.projectOneTitle: Pedido Fácil - Order and Ticket Management System
homeEN.projectOneDescription: Pedido Fácil is a full-stack, cross-platform Point of Sale (POS) solution designed to digitize and optimize restaurant management, from table service to closing the bill. Its architecture is supported by a robust RESTful API in Node.js/TypeScript (using PostgreSQL/Prisma ORM) and establishes real-time communication via Socket.io to synchronize operations between the mobile application (React Native) — dedicated to table management and order placement by waiters — and the administrative web dashboard (Next.js). The system covers user and product control, log monitoring, and payment management, standing out for advanced features like Partial Payment per Order functionality and native integration with Thermal Printers, ensuring agility throughout the operational flow.
homeEN.projectTwoDescription: The SysNevent project is a robust platform for the complete management of the academic event lifecycle, highlighted by its scalable architecture based on Microservices (Node.js/TypeScript) interacting through a central API Gateway, and a modern frontend built with Next.js/React. Key features include event creation and scheduling with date/location availability validation; an efficient participant registration system with automatic email confirmation; real-time Attendance List control via an administrative dashboard; and the ability to Generate Detailed Reports in PDF for analysis and certification, all secured by a Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system that segregates permissions by user profile.
homeEN.aboutTeaser: Passionate about technology and driven by the challenge of creating solutions that make a difference. At {{age}} years old, my journey into the world of development began with curiosity and quickly became a career focused on building efficient and intuitive applications.
homeEN.myJourneyText: Coming from a solid background in IT support, I transitioned to software development to be able to create solutions from scratch. Graduating in Systems Analysis and Development from FATEC was the catalyst that solidified my passion and knowledge.
homeEN.whatIDoText: Today, my focus is on developing complete applications, from the front-end with React to the back-end with Node.js. I have experience creating interactive systems, robust APIs, and delivering projects that provide a great user experience.
